decisions.reason: The area elastic sports system builds on established competence, and industry growth gives slack to carry it, although it lies outside the firm's residential, style-led direction.
Mobile arena floors are a niche project business with uncertain results, but slack from a growing industry lets the firm keep it while it shows results.
As a second mobile arena system that overlaps with B, it is the more likely candidate for consolidation if results fall short, though there is no clear shortfall signal yet.
Chevron parquet is featured on the home page and fits the trend-led, natural-aesthetic residential strategy, so it likely meets aspirations.
The squash court finish is a low-cost niche extension of existing surface know-how that is easy to carry with available slack.
Oak skirting is a simple accessory that supports the sports floor systems and costs little to keep in the range.
